title: A failed chain build names its first failed step and codes in wo_build.qa.chain and on /ops/wo
steps: S1: With TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a disposable PostgreSQL server, run run.cmd.
S2: Confirm both tests named in run.tests report ok.
expect: The measured Central Padel chain (copy CHAIN_BENCH_CHECK_FAILED, write STEP_NINE_CHECK_FAILED) stores failedStep copy, failedCode CHAIN_BENCH_CHECK_FAILED, writeCode STEP_NINE_CHECK_FAILED.
No free text of a step error enters wo_build.qa.
The /ops/wo line reads 'Build stopped at copy (CHAIN_BENCH_CHECK_FAILED); write: STEP_NINE_CHECK_FAILED'; unknown step names and codes read 'unknown'.

tests: a failed chain names the step and the check that stopped it, in bounded codes only
a failed chain is named by its first failed step and code; free text and odd values never pass
